description:
Student loan repayments for a New Zealand based borrower.

    Use for: 'student loan repayment calculator nz', 'student loan threshold
    2026', 'how much student loan will I repay', 'student loan repayment rate nz',
    'how long to pay off student loan nz'.

    12% of every dollar of main-job income over $24,128 a year ($464 a week, $928
    a fortnight, $2,010.66 a month). A secondary job has no threshold. No interest
    for borrowers living in New Zealand. $60,000 a year repays $4,304.64.

    Args:
        annual_income: Main-job salary or wages for the year.
        loan_balance: Optional balance, for the years to repay.
        extra_payment: Optional voluntary payment each period.
        extra_payment_frequency: yearly, monthly, fortnightly or weekly.

    Returns:
        Repayments per year, month, fortnight, week and day, and years to repay.
name: nz_student_loan_repayment_calculator
